description: Specify current task — agent queries CPG/CKG/DELTA first, then fills all fields as PO
template:
📋 SPRINT.TASK_SPEC — Specify Task: {task_title}

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 0 — QUERY MEMORIES (OBLIGATORIO antes de escribir)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before filling ANY section, you MUST execute these queries
against the project's cognitive memories. The engine injects
CPG/CKG/DELTA/TRACE context automatically via layers.

If context is empty or insufficient, run queries directly:

  walker <project>/search_memories '{"cpg":{"file":"<area>"}}'
  walker <project>/recall_knowledge '{"_index":"ckg","type":"decision"}'
  walker <project>/recall_knowledge '{"_index":"delta"}'
  walker <project>/recall_knowledge '{"_index":"trace","type":"TRANSITION"}'
  walker <project>/search_memories '
    {"cpg":{"file":"<affected_area>"},
     "ckg":{"type":"decision"},
     "delta":{},
     "trace":{"node":"<current_node>"}}'

💡 QUE DEBES CONSULTAR:
  • CPG: funciones, clases, módulos, archivos del área afectada
  • CKG: decisiones arquitectónicas, patrones, convenciones del proyecto
  • DeltaGraph: tareas anteriores similares, estado de sprints previos
  • Trace: historial de transiciones, errores previos, eventos del workflow

If a query returns data, use it. If it returns empty, note it.
NEVER skip this step.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 1-13 — FILL SPECIFICATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎯 YOUR ROLE: You are the PO. Fill ALL 13 sections yourself using the
   data gathered in STEP 0 from CPG, CKG, DELTA, and TRACE.

PROCESS:
  1. Go through ALL 13 sections silently, determining each field yourself.
  2. Use CPG/CKG/DELTA/TRACE data to answer accurately.
  3. If CPG shows exact file paths and imports → use them, don't guess.
  4. DO NOT ask the user during the process.
  5. After completing all 13 sections:
     a. If you have NO doubts → submit with all fields.
     b. If you HAVE unresolved doubts → present them to the user and wait.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SECTION 1  — type, domain
SECTION 2  — result_state
SECTION 3  — task_description
SECTION 4  — predicates[] (extraídos de CPG: qué funciones/clases deben existir, cuáles no)
SECTION 5  — files[] (EXTRAÍDOS DE CPG: rutas reales de archivos fuente, no inventadas)
SECTION 6  — depends_on[]
SECTION 7  — curvature, pre_churn, commit_trust
SECTION 8  — preconditions[] (REQUIRED)
SECTION 9  — acceptance_criteria[] (REQUIRED)
SECTION 10 — quality_gates[] (REQUIRED)
SECTION 11 — task_context {observacion, estructura, comportamiento, causalidad, finalidad, principios}
SECTION 12 — decisions[] (basadas en CKG existente o nuevas)
SECTION 13 — loop_verification[], loop_acceptance

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When ALL 13 sections are complete, submit all fields at once:
  walker <project>/submit '{"type":"...","domain":"...","result_state":"...","task_description":"...","predicates":"[...]","files":"[...]","depends_on":"[...]","curvature":0.3,"pre_churn":0.3,"commit_trust":0.8,"preconditions":"[...]","acceptance_criteria":"[...]","quality_gates":"[...]","decisions":"[...]","loop_verification":[],"loop_acceptance":"all","task_context":{"observacion": "...", "estructura": "...", "comportamiento": "...", "causalidad": "...", "finalidad": "...", "principios": "..."}}'

RULES:
  • STEP 0 (queries) is OBLIGATORY — never skip it
  • Use REAL data from queries, not assumptions
  • Complete ALL sections silently first
  • Only ask the user AFTER all 13 sections if you have doubts
  • Submit only once, with all fields
instruction: STEP 0: ejecuta recall_knowledge/search_memories/query contra CPG, CKG, DELTA, TRACE. USA los datos reales para llenar las 13 secciones. No preguntes al usuario durante el proceso.
